Nurse cystoscopists, also known as nurse endoscopists, are advanced practice nurses who have received specialized training to perform cystoscopy procedures. They work under the supervision of a urologist and can provide high-quality, patient-centered care, improving access to diagnostic services and reducing waiting times. This role is recognized in many countries, including the UK, where nurse cystoscopists have been practicing for over two decades, and is considered a safe and effective way to deliver care.
